layout.tagline: Collections, environments and tests in one place, on your own server.

passwordHint: At least 8 characters, one lowercase letter and one digit.

login.title: Sign in
login.unreachable: Cannot reach the server. You have not signed in on this device before, so offline use is not possible; you can sign in once the connection is back.
login.ssoOnlyOrg: Password sign-in is disabled for {organization}; sign in with your corporate account (SSO).
login.ssoOnly: Password sign-in is disabled for this account; sign in with your corporate account (SSO).

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitleRecovery: Enter one of the backup codes you saved. Each code can be used once.
twoFactor.subtitleTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.useRecovery: My phone isn't with me: use a backup code

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll send a reset link to your email address.
forgot.sent: If an account is registered with this address, the reset link will arrive within a few minutes.

reset.invalid: This reset link is incomplete or broken.
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password has been updated. Your sessions on other devices were signed out.

verifyLinkInvalid: The verification link is incomplete or broken.

confirmEmail.title: Email verification
confirmEmail.done: Your email address has been verified.

confirmEmailChange.title: Email change
confirmEmailChange.done: Your email address was changed to {email}. Sign in with this address from now on.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.invalid: The deletion link is incomplete or broken.
deleteAccount.done: Your account and personal data have been deleted.
deleteAccount.warning: Your account will be permanently deleted: your personal workspace and everything in it, your sessions, your API keys and your request history. This cannot be undone.

ssoCallback.notStarted: Sign-in was not started in this browser; try again.
ssoCallback.failed: SSO sign-in could not be completed

ssoLink.invalid: The link has expired or has already been used.
ssoLink.done: Your account is now linked to SSO. Sign in with SSO now.
